svg.title: Route Profitability Gates
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-route-profitability-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Route Profitability Gates; subtitle: No rate gets judged without miles, hours and volume attached; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Are miles, hours, stops and daily volume known?; pass next: G2; fail action: Do not judge the rate; a $350 route at 250 miles and 10-12 hours can lose to a $250 route at 80 miles and 4 hours.; gate: G2; question: Is pay still positive after carrier deductions and fuel?; pass next: G3; fail action: Reprice or pass; $40 an hour with $8 an hour of gas is really $32 an hour, and settlements carry roughly $50 a week in deductions.; gate: G3; question: Are exclusivity, uncapped specimen liability and no-notice termination struck?; pass next: G4; fail action: Negotiate for 30 days notice minimum before signing.; gate: G4; question: Does the carrier contract allow subcontractors?; pass next: Accept and price as a $175 flat daily rate built from $40 an hour, 70 cents a mile and a 25% markup.; fail action: Walk away if the plan is to hire drivers and expand.; caption: Four checks separate a paying route from a $20 job that costs $20 to handle.; assumptions note: The $175 daily rate is Giganomic Era's build for a 2.5-hour, 45-mile morning lab route; other routes need their own build.; note: Sources - Sarah Davis | The D&G Way (hxoZsGym9DU @ 00:08:18); Samuel B. (X99grw6uMuY @ 00:03:30); Dean Medical Courier Academy (q25UyvVRKew @ 00:03:50); Giganomic Era (EgbN0cCrzpk @ 00:01:40, 00:06:19); Dj Mo (twmmoYWAs5Y @ 00:08:07).

circle.title: gate: G1; question: Are miles, hours, stops and daily volume known?; pass next: G2; fail action: Do not judge the rate; a $350 route at 250 miles and 10-12 hours can lose to a $250 route at 80 miles and 4 hours.

gate: G2; question: Is pay still positive after carrier deductions and fuel?; pass next: G3; fail action: Reprice or pass; $40 an hour with $8 an hour of gas is really $32 an hour, and settlements carry roughly $50 a week in deductions.
gate: G3; question: Are exclusivity, uncapped specimen liability and no-notice termination struck?; pass next: G4; fail action: Negotiate for 30 days notice minimum before signing.

gate: G4; question: Does the carrier contract allow subcontractors?; pass next: Accept and price as a $175 flat daily rate built from $40 an hour, 70 cents a mile and a 25% markup.; fail action: Walk away if the plan is to hire drivers and expand.

text.title: Assumptions: The $175 daily rate is Giganomic Era's build for a 2.5-hour, 45-mile morning lab route; other routes need their own build.
